issues.description: Resolver no longer marks requirements as prepared, breaking install flow for non-PEP-658 paths
issues.detail: The resolver previously set req.prepared=True and req.needs_more_preparation=False after preparing. Removing this block means downstream code that checks req.prepared may incorrectly re-process or skip requirements. The install command now calls prepare_linked_requirements_more, but req.prepared is never set to True anywhere in the new flow, which may cause repeated preparation or assertion failures.

issues.description: install --dry-run still calls prepare_linked_requirements_more, defeating the entire purpose of the PR
issues.detail: The install command unconditionally calls preparer.prepare_linked_requirements_more before the dry-run check at line ~414. If this code runs before the dry-run early-return, full wheels will still be downloaded in dry-run mode. The placement of this call relative to the dry-run SUCCESS return needs verification — the diff shows it added without guarding on options.dry_run.

issues.description: direct_url_from_link called with source_dir that may be None for metadata-only fetches
issues.detail: When PEP-658 metadata is fetched, req.source_dir is typically not yet populated since no archive was downloaded/unpacked. Calling direct_url_from_link(req.link, req.source_dir) with None may produce incorrect DirectUrl info or raise. Verify source_dir is valid at this point in the metadata-only branch.

issues.description: Cached _distribution may become stale after full download replaces metadata-only dist
issues.detail: set_dist() stores the metadata-only BaseDistribution. After prepare_linked_requirements_more downloads the full wheel, get_dist() still returns the cached metadata-only distribution because the _distribution check comes first. Consumers expecting the full distribution (with RECORD, files, etc.) will get incomplete data. set_dist needs to be cleared or updated post-download.

issues.description: download command behavior change: prepare_more now runs before save_linked_requirement on all reqs
issues.detail: Previously save_linked_requirement ran first, then prepare_more on all. Now prepare_more runs on all requirements (including already-satisfied ones), then save_linked_requirement iterates. For requirements where satisfied_by is not None, this may trigger unnecessary downloads or change error ordering vs. the prior behavior.

issues.description: set_dist/get_dist asymmetry — setter is trivial but getter has fallback chain; no docstring explains precedence
issues.detail: set_dist unconditionally overwrites _distribution and get_dist prefers _distribution over metadata_directory and local wheel. This precedence is load-bearing but undocumented. Add a comment explaining why cached _distribution wins, and whether callers should ever invalidate it.

review.summary: The PR's intent is sound — defer full wheel downloads until after dry-run validation — but the implementation has correctness gaps. The biggest concern is that removing the resolver's req.prepared=True / needs_more_preparation=False finalization leaves requirements in an inconsistent state for downstream consumers, with no replacement bookkeeping. The install command's new prepare_more call must be verified to sit after the dry-run early return, otherwise the fix is a no-op for the headline use case. The set_dist/get_dist caching also risks returning stale metadata-only distributions after a subsequent full download. Worth a careful trace of req state through each command path before merge.
